title: Threads

card.teaser: A logotype for a youth clothing retailer, drawn as one continuous thread, then animated.

summary: A logotype for a youth clothing retailer, drawn as one continuous thread, then animated.
meta: Static logotype, woven graphic elements, animated logotype

hero.alt: A copper shopping bag printed with the Threads logotype.

overview.challenge: Redesign the logotype for Threads, a clothing retailer for young people, so the name, the clothes and the mark all connect.
overview.solution: Continuous, thread-like strokes for the main mark, with woven secondary strokes that point to the textile without spelling it out.
overview.outcome: A static logotype that sets the shape, and an animated version that keeps it recognizable in motion.
